filtering: No body.documentId accepted. Collection chooses search collection. Document scope is decided before follow-up rewrite; question text is not stripped of document reference.
defaultMode: src/config.ts defaults dense; no RETRIEVE_MODE assignment found in .env or docker-compose.yml. This experiment explicitly holds prior hybrid settings for both A and P.
